statements.venue: Weekly e-newsletter (on a House Education and Workforce subcommittee hearing, "Building an AI-Ready America: Higher Education in the Age of AI")
statements.quote: While technological innovation can create new opportunities, I emphasized the importance of ensuring that human judgment, accountability, and oversight remain central as AI becomes more integrated into the workplace.
statements.context: Summary of his questioning at a hearing on how colleges prepare students for jobs as AI spreads through the workplace.
statements.reason: About AI in the workplace, jobs and human oversight of work decisions; no catastrophic risk is acknowledged.

statements.venue: Weekly e-newsletter (on a House Oversight Committee hearing on AI held Thursday 5 June 2025)
statements.quote: While AI offers promising technological advancements, from eliminating waste, fraud, and abuse in our government to enhancing efficiency, there are also serious risks if it’s not handled responsibly.
statements.context: Summary of an Oversight Committee hearing on AI; the next sentences say Republicans support AI innovation but not at the expense of American jobs or personal freedoms, and criticize a regulation-first approach.
statements.reason: Mentions unspecified "serious risks", but the surrounding text names only jobs and personal freedoms, which are outside the catastrophic-risk scope; could be read as a general C.
